title: Before the first visit
body: A useful new-client page can explain which records and medication notes the clinic wants before arrival—after the clinic approves the checklist.

title: Appointment requests need a finish line
body: A website request is not a confirmed appointment. The clearest experience tells pet owners what happens after they submit and who confirms the visit.

title: Clinical content stays human-reviewed
body: Veterinary services and urgent guidance should remain under item-level clinic approval. That boundary is part of the production system, not fine print.
